REF-01.title: {countPhrase} {verb} not references
REF-01.detail: The exact string “{keyword}” appears as plain text in {names}. Those copies will not update.

REF-02.title: {countPhrase} {pointVerb} at a deleted keyword
REF-02.detail: {names} reference a keyword that no longer exists. Those references render as “Unknown keyword”.

REF-03.title: {countPhrase} {pointVerb} at a deleted article
REF-03.detail: {names} reference an article that no longer exists. Those links render as “Unknown article” and export without a target.

REF-04.title: {countPhrase} {pointVerb} at a deleted diagram
REF-04.detail: {names} reference a diagram that no longer exists. Those embeds export as an empty block.

REF-05.title: {countPhrase} {pointVerb} at a deleted image
REF-05.detail: {names} reference an image that no longer exists. Those embeds export as a blank box.

REF-06.title: {countPhrase} {verb} no stored file
REF-06.detail: {names} exist in the registry but the bytes are gone from local storage.

REF-09.title: {countPhrase} {resolveVerb} to nothing
REF-09.detail: {names} {haveVerb} no full text. A Live: Full text reference to it exports empty.

REF-10.title: {countPhrase} {resolveVerb} to nothing
REF-10.detail: {names} {haveVerb} no short text. A Live: Summary reference to it exports empty.

REF-11.title: {countPhrase} {linkVerb} into a notes article
REF-11.detail: {names}. Notes articles are excluded from the export, so the anchor breaks.

REF-12.title: Deep live-embed chain
REF-12.detail: {start} pulls text through {hopsPhrase} of live references.

CON-02.title: {countPhrase} {verb} no text at all
CON-02.detail: {names} {verb} neither a short text nor a full text.

CON-03.title: {countPhrase} {shape}
CON-03.detail: {names} {verb} no body text and no child sections.

CON-05.title: {countPhrase} {verb} no display name
CON-05.detail: References to {pronoun} render as a blank link and cannot be found by the suggestion menu.

CON-06.title: Duplicate short text
CON-06.detail: {names} share an identical short text string.

CON-08.title: Duplicate keyword name
CON-08.detail: {count} keywords are named {name}; suggestions and auto-linking cannot tell them apart.

CON-09.title: Keyword names differ only by case or plural

CON-11.title: {countPhrase} {exceedVerb} the summary budget
CON-11.detail: {names} run past {limit} characters, which crowds any Live: Summary reference.

CON-12.title: {countPhrase} left in body text
CON-12.detail: TODO, TBD, FIXME or ??? appears in {names}.

CON-13.title: {countPhrase} still {verb} author notes
CON-13.detail: Notes are draft-only — they appear in the draft export and are omitted from the rulebook.

CON-15.title: Ruleset metadata incomplete
CON-15.detail: No {names} is set on this ruleset; the export's title page falls back to a placeholder.

STR-01.title: {countPhrase} {verb} not in the structure tree
STR-01.detail: {names} exist in the registry but {verb} unreachable from the tree, so {pronoun} never export.

STR-02.title: {countPhrase} {pointVerb} at a missing article
STR-02.detail: {subject} an article id that is not in the registry.

STR-03.title: {countPhrase} {appearVerb} twice in the tree
STR-03.detail: {names} {occupyVerb} more than one place in the structure; export numbers and anchors collide.

STR-04.title: {countPhrase} {verb} a single child
STR-04.detail: {names} {containVerb} exactly one article; the nesting may not be earning its level.

STR-06.title: {countPhrase} {verb} no internal headings
STR-06.detail: {list} with no heading to break it up.

STR-08.title: {countPhrase} {verb} inside an exported section
STR-08.detail: {names} {fallVerb} between two exported articles and leaves a gap in the numbering.

DIA-01.title: {countPhrase} {doVerb} not parse
DIA-01.detail: {names} {failVerb} to render and exports as an error block.

DIA-02.title: {countPhrase} {verb} empty
DIA-02.detail: {names} {verb} no content beyond the starter template.

DIA-03.title: {countPhrase} {verb} no name
DIA-03.detail: {pronoun} without a caption and cannot be found by name when inserting.
